progression.narrative: The performance opens on Ck3 and dwells most on C# in Reng-e Shalakhu. The line peaks at F#4 (367.4 Hz) at 1:06.3. It closes on C#4, not the tonic (F4 → E4 → C#4 → D#4 → F#4 → C#4).
